recipes.title: Classic Red Borscht
instructions: 1. Grate beets and sauté with lemon juice and tomato paste for 10 mins.
2. Boil 8 cups of water or broth. Add diced potatoes and shredded cabbage.
3. Sauté onions and carrots until golden, then add to the pot.
4. Add the sautéed beets to the soup and simmer for 30 mins until tender.
5. Serve with a dollop of low-fat Greek yogurt and fresh dill.

recipes.title: Shchi (Fresh Cabbage Soup)
instructions: 1. Shred the cabbage and dice the potatoes.
2. Bring 6 cups of water to a boil and add cabbage and potatoes.
3. Sauté chopped onion and grated carrot until soft, then stir into the soup.
4. Simmer on medium-low for 35 mins. Season with salt, pepper, and bay leaves.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Kasha with Roasted Onions
instructions: 1. Rinse buckwheat thoroughly in cold water.
2. Combine buckwheat and water in a pot. Bring to a boil.
3. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-18 mins until water is absorbed.
4. Meanwhile, sauté onions in a teaspoon of oil until caramelized.
5. Fluff kasha with a fork and stir in the golden onions.

recipes.title: Vinegret (Beet and Pickle Salad)
instructions: 1. Dice the boiled beets, potatoes, and pickles into 1/4 inch cubes.
2. In a large bowl, combine the diced vegetables and peas.
3. Dress with 1 tbsp sunflower or olive oil and a dash of salt.
4. Mix well until everything is coated in the vibrant red beet juice. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Ukha (Clear Fish Soup)
instructions: 1. Bring 5 cups of water to a boil. Add diced potatoes and a whole onion (to be removed later).
2. Simmer for 10 mins. Add the fish, cut into large chunks.
3. Simmer gently for 15 mins. Remove the onion.
4. Season with black peppercorns and salt. Stir in a generous amount of chopped fresh dill just before serving.

recipes.title: Sorrel Schi (Green Borscht)
instructions: 1. Boil diced potatoes in 4 cups of water until soft.
2. Finely chop the sorrel and add to the pot. Cook for only 2-3 mins (sorrel wilts fast).
3. Turn off heat. Stir in chopped hard-boiled eggs.
4. Serve hot or cold with a dollop of yogurt.

recipes.title: Garlic Roasted Rabbit
instructions: 1. Rub rabbit pieces with crushed garlic, salt, and pepper.
2. Lightly coat with sour cream.
3. Place in a roasting dish, cover with foil, and bake at 350F for 40 mins.
4. Remove foil and roast for another 10 mins until golden.

recipes.title: Baked Honey-Cinnamon Apples
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375F.
2. Core the apples but do not cut all the way through the bottom.
3. Fill the center of each apple with honey and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
4. Place in a baking dish with a splash of water at the bottom.
5. Bake for 20-25 mins until the apples are soft but still hold their shape.

recipes.title: Barley Mushroom Pot
instructions: 1. If using dried mushrooms, soak in hot water for 20 mins.
2. Boil 6 cups of water. Add rinsed barley and simmer for 20 mins.
3. Sauté chopped mushrooms and onions, then add to the barley.
4. Simmer for another 20 mins until barley is tender and chewy.

recipes.title: Garlic Steamed Zucchini
instructions: 1. Slice zucchini into half-moons.
2. Steam for 8-10 mins until tender.
3. Toss immediately with fresh minced garlic and a pinch of salt while hot.

recipes.title: Lean Olivier Salad
instructions: 1. Combine diced turkey, pickles, and chopped egg in a bowl.
2. Add boiled peas and diced carrots if available.
3. Mix with Greek yogurt (replaces mayo) and a touch of mustard.
4. Season with salt and lots of black pepper.

recipes.title: Herb Infused Kefir
instructions: 1. Pour kefir into a glass.
2. Stir in grated cucumber and dill.
3. Enjoy as a refreshing, gut-healthy snack.

recipes.title: Okroshka (Cold Kefir Soup)
instructions: 1. Finely dice cucumber, radishes, and the boiled egg.
2. Place in a bowl and pour ice-cold kefir over the top.
3. Season with salt and garnish with green onions and dill. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Onion-Baked Pollock
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400F.
2. Place fish on a baking sheet lined with onion rings.
3. Squeeze lemon over the fish and season with salt.
4. Bake for 12-15 mins until the fish flakes easily.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage (Golubtsi - Lean)
instructions: 1. Blanch cabbage leaves in boiling water until pliable.
2. Mix turkey and rice together. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Place a portion of meat in each leaf and roll tightly.
4. Arrange rolls in a pot, cover with tomato sauce, and simmer for 40 mins on low heat.

recipes.title: Boiled Beef Tongue Platter
instructions: 1. Boil tongue in water with bay leaves and peppercorns for 2 hours.
2. Immediately plunge into cold water to peel off the outer skin.
3. Slice very thin. Serve cold with horseradish or mustard.

recipes.title: Spring Radish Salad
instructions: 1. Toss sliced radishes and chives in a bowl.
2. Drizzle with oil and a pinch of salt. Serve as a bright side dish.

recipes.title: Buckwheat-Stuffed Pumpkin
instructions: 1. Cut the top off the pumpkin and remove seeds.
2. Mix cooked buckwheat and sautéed mushrooms. Fill the pumpkin.
3. Place the top back on. Bake at 350F for 1 hour until the pumpkin flesh is soft.

recipes.title: Lite Mushroom Stroganoff
instructions: 1. Sauté onions and mushrooms until golden.
2. Turn off the heat. Stir in Greek yogurt (do not boil, or it will curdle).
3. Season with salt and lots of black pepper. Serve over buckwheat.

recipes.title: Baked Trout with Lemon & Garlic
instructions: 1. Make shallow slits in the trout. Insert garlic slivers.
2. Squeeze lemon over the fish.
3. Bake at 375F for 20 mins until cooked through.

recipes.title: Russian Cabbage Slaw
instructions: 1. Mix shredded cabbage and grated carrot.
2. Massage with a little salt to soften.
3. Toss with vinegar and a touch of oil.

recipes.title: Kasha with Wild Berries
instructions: 1. Cook oats in water according to package.
2. Stir in berries and a drop of honey just before serving.

recipes.title: Kiev Chicken (Baked Version)
instructions: 1. Flatten chicken breasts. Place a small piece of herb butter in the center.
2. Roll tightly and secure with toothpicks.
3. Bake at 400F for 25 mins instead of frying.

recipes.title: Traditional Probiotic Sauerkraut
instructions: 1. Shred cabbage thin. Mix with salt.
2. Pack tightly into a jar until juices rise above cabbage.
3. Let sit at room temperature for 3-5 days to ferment.

recipes.title: Egg and Dill Salad
instructions: 1. Chop eggs and dill.
2. Mix with yogurt and a dash of mustard. Serve on whole wheat toast.

recipes.title: Turkey Stuffed Peppers
instructions: 1. Core peppers. Stuff with mixture of ground turkey and cooked rice.
2. Place in a baking dish with 1 cup of water and tomato paste.
3. Bake at 375F for 40 mins.

recipes.title: Cold Summer Beet Soup
instructions: 1. Mix grated beets with ice-cold kefir.
2. Add chopped cucumber and hard-boiled egg.
3. Chill and serve with plenty of fresh dill.

recipes.title: Steamed Salmon with Garlic-Dill
instructions: 1. Steam salmon for 10-12 mins.
2. Toss dill, garlic, and 1 tsp oil. Brush over the hot fish.

recipes.title: Buckwheat and Zucchini Sauté
instructions: 1. Sauté diced zucchini with onions until soft.
2. Stir in cooked buckwheat and heat through.

recipes.title: Chicken and Prune Roast
instructions: 1. Place chicken and prunes in a baking dish.
2. Add garlic and a splash of water.
3. Bake at 375F for 45 mins until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Chewy Barley with Raspberries
instructions: 1. Cook barley in water until chewy and soft.
2. Top with fresh berries and a sprinkle of cinnamon.

recipes.title: New Potatoes with Dill & Sea Salt
instructions: 1. Boil unpeeled potatoes until tender.
2. Drain and toss with fresh dill and coarse sea salt while steaming hot.

recipes.title: Quick Garlic Dill Pickles
instructions: 1. Slice cucumbers into spears.
2. Pack into a jar with garlic and dill.
3. Pour over a simple brine of water and salt. Refrigerate for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Millet Porridge
instructions: 1. Simmer millet and pumpkin together in water or low-fat milk.
2. Cook until the pumpkin has dissolved into a creamy orange porridge.

recipes.title: Lean Chicken Liver and Onions
instructions: 1. Sauté onions in a non-stick pan with a drop of oil.
2. Add liver and sear quickly (approx 3 mins per side) to keep it tender and healthy.

recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Turkey Roast
instructions: 1. Rub turkey with a mix of dried herbs and salt.
2. Roast at 350F for 1 hour until internal temp reaches 165F.

recipes.title: Vegetable Ragout (Russian Stew)
instructions: 1. Layer diced vegetables in a pot with a little water and tomato paste.
2. Simmer covered for 30 mins until all veggies are tender.

recipes.title: Baked Cod on Onion Bed
instructions: 1. Arrange onion rings on a baking sheet.
2. Place fish on top and bake at 400F for 15-20 mins.

recipes.title: Apple-Celery Fiber Salad
instructions: 1. Dice apple and celery.
2. Toss with a dressing made of Greek yogurt and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Lean Beef and Cabbage Soup
instructions: 1. Slow simmer beef chunks until tender.
2. Add shredded cabbage and simmer for another 30 mins.

recipes.title: Poached Halibut with Fresh Herbs
instructions: 1. Simmer fish in a very small amount of herb-infused water for 8 mins.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Kasha with Walnuts
instructions: 1. Cook buckwheat.
2. Stir in crushed walnuts for healthy fats and crunch.

recipes.title: Honey-Roasted Parsnips
instructions: 1. Toss parsnips with oil and a drizzle of honey.
2. Roast at 400F until caramelized.

recipes.title: Baked Meatballs with Rice (Tefteli)
instructions: 1. Mix beef and rice. Form into small balls.
2. Bake in a light tomato sauce for 30 mins.

recipes.title: Savory Mushroom Caviar
instructions: 1. Sauté mushrooms and onions.
2. Pulse in a blender until it reaches a spreadable texture.

recipes.title: Cold Roast Veal Slices
instructions: 1. Roast veal until juicy.
2. Let cool completely, slice paper-thin, and serve with mustard.

recipes.title: Wild Berry Compote (No Sugar)
instructions: 1. Simmer berries in 4 cups water.
2. Sweeten with a touch of stevia if needed. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Light Spinach-Egg Drop Soup
instructions: 1. Simmer spinach in broth.
2. Drizzle in whisked eggs slowly while stirring.

recipes.title: Baked Cod and Carrot Medley
instructions: 1. Layer fish and carrots on foil.
2. Bake at 375F for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Roasted Garlic Beet Dip
instructions: 1. Roast whole beets and garlic in foil.
2. Peel and blend together until smooth. Season with salt.
